scope: Validation-panel design and source/evidence scouting only. No labels, registries, ontologies, thresholds, production scoring, imports, or model outputs were edited.

provenance_tier_definitions.gold: M-CSA curated mechanism plus local structure/cofactor context that can anchor the review panel, not a new production label.
provenance_tier_definitions.silver_review_only: Mechanism-useful row with expert caveat, coordinate caveat, duplicate/family hold, or future-child status; review diagnostics only.
provenance_tier_definitions.bronze_source_only: External/source-only lead or source boundary row; structure, duplicate/leakage, terminal review, and import gates incomplete.
provenance_tier_definitions.hard_negative_control: Near-family or out-of-scope control expected to route away from the flavin hydride-transfer and FMO children.

panel_summary.primary_observation: The v1 flavin bucket is too broad for validation: flavin hydride transfer, Fe-S relay, covalent FAD adduct, radical FAD/Fe-S dehydration, flavodiiron NO reduction, oxidase-only O2 use, and C4a-peroxy oxygen insertion need separate routing evidence.

router_generalization_success_criteria: Clean hydride-transfer rows route to flavin hydride/dehydrogenase-reductase and do not absorb FMO, oxidase-only, radical, covalent-adduct, or flavodiiron rows.

FMO rows require reduced FAD/FMN plus O2/C4a-(hydro)peroxy or equivalent peroxyflavin oxygen-transfer evidence and substrate oxygenation context; NADP(H) absence is tolerated for partner-supplied FMNH2 systems.
m_csa:497 routes to flavodiiron/non-heme diiron NO reduction or abstains, with FMNH2 treated as electron donor rather than catalytic flavin hydride locus.
m_csa:750 routes to radical flavin/Fe-S dehydratase or abstains, not to ordinary hydride-transfer or FMO.
m_csa:123 routes to covalent FAD-substrate adduct/boundary chemistry or abstains, not to FMO.
Flavin oxidases with O2 as terminal electron acceptor route away from FMO because they do not insert O2-derived oxygen into substrate.
Heme, P450, pterin, non-heme-iron, copper, and luciferin/ATP oxygenases route to their own hard-negative/OOS controls despite oxygenase wording.
ontology_too_broad_failure_criteria: Any high-confidence FMO prediction on flavin oxidase-only rows such as m_csa:109, m_csa:110, m_csa:113, m_csa:354, m_csa:822, m_csa:852, or m_csa:895.
Any high-confidence clean hydride-transfer prediction on m_csa:497, m_csa:750, or m_csa:123 without preserving the non-heme diiron, radical Fe-S, or covalent-adduct locus.
Any positive FMO call driven by FAD/FMN plus NAD(P)H/O2 words without substrate oxygen insertion or C4a/peroxyflavin evidence.
Any collapse of heme/P450/pterin/non-heme-iron/copper oxygenases into flavin monooxygenase because of oxygenase vocabulary.
Any requirement that two-component FMNH2 oxygenases carry local NADP(H) ligand in the oxygenase coordinate before routing to FMO review support.
